features.title: Browse every shared component on one page
features.summary: A main panel that renders every @dshfiles/plugin-ui component live, animated ones included, in one tab per category, with a filter over titles and import paths, a per-card and page-wide Replay, and a reduced-motion indicator.
failureModes: A demo that throws renders an inline error naming the component with a Replay retry instead of blanking the page.
A filter with no match says so and tells the user to clear it.

verification.testName: filters by every word across title, description and import path
counts demos and reports duplicate ids across categories

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the gallery renders browser state from bundled demo data and starts no Host work of its own.
